page_title: VIL 3-0 RAY | Villarreal v Rayo Vallecano 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alex Baena (Villarreal).

90+3' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Stole Dimitrievski is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Villarreal.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) launches a cross from the corner, but Filip Jorgensen is alert to thwart the effort.

89' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner.
89' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
86' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
84' Substitution. Alexander Sorloth did his best and is replaced by Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal).
84' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Dani Parejo will be replaced by Manu Trigueros (Villarreal).
84' A substitution has been made. Goncalo Guedes is replaced by Ramon Terrats (Villarreal).
83' The attendance is 17869.
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Miguel Crespo will be replaced by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
80' Here is a change. Isi Palazon is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
80' The substitution is prepared. Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pathe Ciss.
78' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
77' Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

74' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Alex Baena slips the ball through to Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:0.
73' Marcelino has decided to substitute Alberto Moreno and he is replaced by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).
72' It is time for a substitution. Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) is on for Ilias Akhomach.
69' 2 - 0 GOAL! The corner is whipped in and Yerson Mosquera (Villarreal) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the top left corner. He makes it 2:0.
69' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

69' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) hits a shot towards the top of the net from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Stole Dimitrievski. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Flag up against Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
64' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Sergio Camello.
64' Substitution. Unai Lopez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
63' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
61' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
60' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. They send men into the box.
60' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

60' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
57' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
53' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

51' What a great touch by Alex Baena (Villarreal)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.
43' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle and it's Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
42' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
41' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
35' A pass from Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Filip Jorgensen and the move breaks down.
32' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Villarreal players look gutted.
31' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand. Let’s see what happens!
30' Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 2:0.
24' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

24' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
18' 1 - 0 Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!

18' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom right corner, but Filip Jorgensen makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
13' The ball is cleared after Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.
11' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
8' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.
4' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
